mapper.sql: CASE WHEN p.cntrct_ty_cd='TK' THEN to_char(b.bill_dt,'YYYY-MM') ELSE b.atrb_ym END
mapper.select: SELECT AS month, CAST(SUM(b.sply_amt) AS BIGINT) AS confirmed_supply_amt FROM bill.bill b JOIN prj.prj p ON p.prj_id=b.prj_id WHERE b.bill_stts_cd='CONFIRM' AND p.cntrct_ty_cd IN ('TK','MO','DP') AND >= #{from} AND <= #{to} GROUP BY ORDER BY month

SELECT r.rcpt_id AS receipt_id, r.bill_id, r.rcpt_dt, r.rcpt_amt FROM bill.rcpt r JOIN bill.bill b ON b.bill_id=r.bill_id WHERE b.bill_stts_cd='CONFIRM' AND b.amnd_yn='N' AND r.rcpt_dt >= #{start} AND r.rcpt_dt < #{endExclusive} ORDER BY r.rcpt_dt, r.rcpt_id

SELECT CAST(COALESCE(SUM(b.sply_amt),0) AS BIGINT) AS confirmed_supply_amt, COUNT(*) AS confirmed_count FROM bill.bill b JOIN prj.prj p ON p.prj_id=b.prj_id WHERE b.prj_id=#{projectId} AND b.bill_stts_cd='CONFIRM' AND p.cntrct_ty_cd IN ('TK','MO','DP') AND = #{month}

SELECT b.bill_id, b.bill_stts_cd, b.amnd_yn, b.tot_amt AS original_total_amt, CAST(COALESCE((SELECT SUM(a.tot_amt) FROM bill.bill a WHERE a.orgnl_bill_id=b.bill_id AND a.amnd_yn='Y' AND a.bill_stts_cd='CONFIRM'),0) AS BIGINT) AS confirmed_adjustment_amt, CAST(COALESCE((SELECT SUM(r.rcpt_amt) FROM bill.rcpt r WHERE r.bill_id=b.bill_id),0) AS BIGINT) AS received_amt FROM bill.bill b WHERE b.bill_id=#{billId}
